title: Austin Utility Lawsuit: All-Day Closed Session
summary:
*   **Extended Closed-Door Meeting:** The special Sunday gathering was held entirely in executive (closed-door) sessions, lasting from late morning until late at night.
*   **Key Lawsuit Discussions:** The primary focus of the confidential talks was ongoing litigation in the "City of Austin v. Houston Lighting and Power" case.
*   **Other Private Matters:** Discussions also included sensitive topics such as potential land acquisitions and personnel matters.
*   **No Public Policy Decisions:** No public votes, policy decisions, or official actions were taken during this special meeting. The only open announcement was to reschedule an upcoming meeting.
